content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Motion control motors and drives for industrial equipment; different products from Cirrus's audio and sensing semiconductor chips."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients for personal care and coatings; no overlap with semiconductor chip design."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Construction products, HVAC and fluid-handling components; a different business from chip design."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"IoT connectivity hardware and cloud device software sold to businesses; adjacent to devices but not chip design for consumer electronics."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Replacement automotive aftermarket parts sold through retailers; not semiconductor chips sold to device makers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Distributes components and fasteners from stock; a distributor, not a fabless chip designer."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals and materials sold to manufacturers; a chemical producer, not semiconductors."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Online custom machining and injection-molded prototype parts; a contract manufacturer rather than chip designer."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Precision bearings for aerospace and industrial machinery; mechanical components unlike mixed-signal chips."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Automotive locks, keys and door systems built in own plants; mechanical access products, not semiconductors."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Hospital medical devices such as catheters and surgical instruments; a different business and customer base."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Industrial hardware, locks and metal castings made in owned plants; mechanical products, not chip design."}]}
